description: Endogenous macroeconomic, demographic, and fiscal feedback parameters for Sandvox CLI (run_simulation.py)

_provenance._note: Provenance for every feedback parameter (hygiene track G). Labels: S = anchored to a published figure or institution; T = calibrated tuning constant (a modelling assumption, no external source); internal = a definition or design threshold of this model itself. The loader ignores this section.

ed_budget_unit_bn.label: T
ed_budget_unit_bn.basis: normalization unit: the TFR boost is quoted per this much education-budget delta (calibration choice)

ed_tfr_boost_per_unit.label: T
ed_tfr_boost_per_unit.basis: calibrated elasticity of TFR to education support

discontent_baseline.label: internal
discontent_baseline.basis: the CLI's neutral discontent anchor (0.20), shared with the approval and stress channels

discontent_tfr_slope.label: T
discontent_tfr_slope.basis: calibrated; sign follows the household-stress/fertility literature, magnitude tuned in the v4 calibration

food_infl_threshold.label: T
food_infl_threshold.basis: food-inflation level above which the fertility drag binds (calibration)

food_infl_tfr_slope.label: T
food_infl_tfr_slope.basis: calibrated fertility drag per unit of excess food inflation

real_wage_tfr_slope.label: T
real_wage_tfr_slope.basis: calibrated fertility response to real-wage growth

stress_drag_min.label: T
stress_drag_min.basis: clamp on the total fertility stress drag

stress_drag_max.label: T
stress_drag_max.basis: clamp on the total fertility stress boost

tfr_floor.label: T
tfr_floor.basis: plausibility bound (below any recorded national TFR)

structural_baseline.label: S
structural_baseline.basis: anchored to Japan's recent net-migration scale (ISA / MIC population estimates: mid-2010s to 2020s net inflow roughly 150-250k/yr); rounded anchor

reopening_decay_years.label: T
reopening_decay_years.basis: calibrated horizon over which the post-reopening migration surge decays

cap_ssw_multiplier.label: T
cap_ssw_multiplier.basis: calibrated pass-through from the SSW visa cap to total inflow capacity

cap_saturation_scale.label: T
cap_saturation_scale.basis: calibrated saturation scale of the capacity response

cap_headroom_floor.label: T
cap_headroom_floor.basis: calibrated minimum headroom of the migration capacity term

infl_attract_threshold.label: T
infl_attract_threshold.basis: inflation level above which Japan's attractiveness to migrants decays

infl_attract_slope.label: T
infl_attract_slope.basis: calibrated attractiveness decay per unit of excess inflation

discontent_attract_threshold.label: T
discontent_attract_threshold.basis: discontent level above which attractiveness decays

discontent_attract_slope.label: T
discontent_attract_slope.basis: calibrated attractiveness decay per unit of excess discontent

real_wage_attract_slope.label: T
real_wage_attract_slope.basis: calibrated attractiveness response to real-wage growth

old_75plus_cost_weight.label: S
old_75plus_cost_weight.basis: MHLW national medical and long-term-care cost profiles: per-capita cost at 75+ is roughly 3.5x the 65-74 band (the model's documented basis since v4)

senior_relief_multiplier.label: T
senior_relief_multiplier.basis: calibrated strength of the pension-age employment relief on social-security cost growth

infl_index_threshold.label: S
infl_index_threshold.basis: the Bank of Japan's 2% price-stability target: only excess inflation compounds into the budget index

jgb_infl_threshold.label: S
jgb_infl_threshold.basis: the Bank of Japan's 2% price-stability target: the yield responds to inflation above it

jgb_infl_slope.label: T
jgb_infl_slope.basis: calibrated 10y-yield response per unit of excess inflation

jgb_debt_gdp_slope.label: T
jgb_debt_gdp_slope.basis: calibrated 10y-yield response per unit of debt/GDP above its initial level

jgb_bond_dep_threshold.label: T
jgb_bond_dep_threshold.basis: bond-dependence level above which the yield premium binds (calibration)

jgb_bond_dep_slope.label: T
jgb_bond_dep_slope.basis: calibrated yield premium per unit of excess bond dependence

crisis_bond_dep_threshold.label: internal
crisis_bond_dep_threshold.basis: the model's CRISIS definition: bond dependence above 45% (endogenous crisis rule since v2)

jgb_crisis_slope.label: T
jgb_crisis_slope.basis: calibrated additional yield slope inside CRISIS

jgb_rollover_years.label: S
jgb_rollover_years.basis: average remaining maturity of outstanding JGBs, about 8.5-9 years (MOF debt-management publications, FY2024)

crisis_infl_premium.label: T
crisis_infl_premium.basis: calibrated inflation premium added inside CRISIS

crisis_food_premium.label: T
crisis_food_premium.basis: calibrated food-price premium added inside CRISIS

vat_food_passthrough.label: T
vat_food_passthrough.basis: calibrated pass-through of consumption-tax changes to food prices

vat_ongoing_food_bite.label: T
vat_ongoing_food_bite.basis: calibrated ongoing share of the tax bite on household food costs

min_sample_ratio.label: internal
min_sample_ratio.basis: design threshold: replenish when the panel falls below this share of its initial size (with the P6 cadence trigger, since the household layer self-renews and the ratio alone never fires)

min_sample_abs.label: internal
min_sample_abs.basis: design threshold: absolute floor for the panel size trigger
